en.t: I went back to my hometown in February and took a few days off.

units.source_text: 想你一定会来，所以十四日才赶回来的。

en.t: I was sure you would come, so I hurried back on the fourteenth.

units.source_text: 早知你没来，我多护理几天再来就好了。”

en.t: If I had known you weren't coming, I would have stayed to care for him a few more days before coming back.
